hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in *.env|*.env.local|*.env.*) [ "${f##*/}" = ".env.example" ] || { echo "blocked: real env file. Use .env.example." >&2; exit 2; };; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.astro|*.css|*.mjs|*.json) npx prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null;; esac 2>/dev/null || true
